svg.aria-label: Sketch after an Al Jazeera photograph: a polling station in an old St. Petersburg hall, two voting booths hung with curtains on thin tube frames in front of a painted mural of eighteenth-century figures, a man in a long coat stepping out of one booth holding ballot papers and a woman stepping out of the other, a police officer reclining on a slatted bench at left, a small girl in a puffer jacket holding an umbrella in the right foreground, and a parquet floor; every figure drawn as a contour with no facial features.
